_doc: UD -> project relation conversion table (DATA). version 0 (draft). Rules are matched top to bottom, first match wins. Fields: ud = full or base (before ':') deprel, or an internal pseudo-relation made by an operation; dep_upos / head_upos = UPOS lists; dep_feat = 'Key=Val' that must be in the dependent's FEATS. No word lists anywhere. 'ops' are named structural operations applied in 'op_order'.

drop_punct.note: punctuation is not a node in the project format

copula_swap.note: predicate loses head role: the copula becomes head, takes the predicate's own place and relation, and receives its subject/aux/clausal dependents; the predicate becomes its child (label by predicate UPOS via the 'pred' rules)

phrase_head_swap.name: adposition_heads_noun
phrase_head_swap.note: case marker becomes head of the phrase and takes its relation to the outer head (chain if several); the old phrase head becomes its child

phrase_head_swap.name: subordinator_heads_clause
phrase_head_swap.note: mark becomes head of its clause; the clause head becomes its child

coord_lift.note: the first coordinator (cc) takes the place of the first conjunct in the tree; first conjunct and all conj dependents become its children. Without cc the later conjuncts hang under the first (asyndeton).

rules.label: SUBORDINATION
rules._note: fallback for marker nodes that took their clause's relation
